symptom: The PR runtime Date.parse-based instant validator accepts impossible Gregorian dates such as 2026-02-30, normalizing them to a later calendar day. Offline negative-control tests failed 5 of 19 assertions; calendar-aware candidate passed 19 of 19, but is not committed or CI-verified.
lesson: Date.parse accepting an ISO-shaped string does not prove that its Gregorian calendar day exists. Reject invalid month/day/leap-year combinations before admission, hashing or cohort enrollment.
guardrail: Validate year/month/day against the proleptic Gregorian calendar and validate hour/minute/second and timezone bounds before Date.parse. Require negative fixtures for Feb 30, non-leap Feb 29, Apr 31 and century leap rules, then run repository CI on committed code.
